name: Josu Vess
description: Josu Vess is Liliana's brother, whom her attempt to heal him raised as an undead, later a lich general in Belzenlok's service.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

summary.text: Josu Vess is Liliana's brother, whom her attempt to heal him raised as an undead, later a lich general in Belzenlok's service.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: Liliana killed her brother Josu, and the root of destruction planted by that act haunts her as she tries to avoid following him into the void.

citations.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.
"Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

bio.text: Her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before Liliana fled.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: On Dominaria, Liliana saw that the lich leading the Cabal's forces had Josu's face, and learned that Belzenlok had made him his servant and commander.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: She realized Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him, and she vowed to free Josu.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: She called Josu to the manor, where he appeared in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general, and the Veil destroyed him.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

bio.text: With his last words he blamed Liliana for the curse of the House of Vess, and he dissolved into dust.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

bio.text: Liliana later admitted she sees him all the time now, and used her brother to taunt Belzenlok.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

status.text: Josu is dead, destroyed by the Chain Veil and dissolved into dust, though Liliana still sees him.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: An Onakke spirit calls her vessel and tells her the root planted when she killed her brother will bloom into destruction; it also says she acts to avoid following Josu into the void.
timeline.quote: Everything you've done has been to avoid following Josu into the void.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls how her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before she fled as her spark ignited (flashback).
timeline.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster that killed Lady Ana, killed her servants

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tracing the knight's connection, Liliana sees the lich's face is Josu's.
timeline.quote: An image of the lich's face burned before her. The face was Josu's.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A captured cleric reveals Belzenlok made Josu his servant and commander of his forces.
timeline.quote: He has made your precious brother into his servant, the commander of his unholy forces!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to free Josu and make Belzenlok pay.
timeline.quote: You'll pay for this, Belzenlok,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man says Josu cannot be laid to rest and that Liliana should have followed him.
timeline.quote: It can't be done.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
timeline.quote: He knew if Liliana used the Chain Veil to unmake Josu, it would leave her so weak she wouldn't be able to use it to destroy Belzenlok.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu.
timeline.quote: The lich leading the Cabal forces in this area is my brother, Josu.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana confesses she made Josu undead as a girl.
timeline.quote: I made Josu undead, many years ago.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls to Josu through the wind, drawing him to the manor.
timeline.quote: Josu Vess, I am here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu appears in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general.
timeline.quote: The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Veil destroys Josu, leaving his decomposing corpse.
timeline.quote: crumpled before her on the paving stones was the decomposing corpse of her brother.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: With his last words Josu blames Liliana for the curse of the House of Vess.
timeline.quote: You killed me. You killed them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu dissolves into dust.
timeline.quote: And he was gone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she sees Josu all the time now.
timeline.quote: I see Josu all the time, now.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana taunts Belzenlok about her brother and the pact signers she has killed to draw him away from Gideon.
timeline.quote: You should have left my brother alone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses the Veil on Dominaria to break the lich spell on her brother Josu.
timeline.quote: Liliana used the Veil again on Dominaria

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana defeat Belzenlok on Dominaria, with Gideon killing him using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: which he ultimately used to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu is afflicted by a magical illness in battle against his father's enemies.
timeline.quote: Josu was afflicted by a magical illness in battle against his father's enemies.

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Cursed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses a stranger's cure on Josu, driving him insane and poisoning him anew.
timeline.quote: It cured Josu of his affliction, but at the cost of driving him insane and poisoning him anew.

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Undead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana turns his victims into zombies to fight him and unlocks her planeswalker spark, ending up on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: she unlocked her planeswalker's spark and ended up on Innistrad

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Undead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The undead Josu kills his father; the rest of the family fails to stop him, creating the Curse of Vess.
timeline.quote: was himself killed instead by the undead Josu

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Undead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabal captures Josu and makes him a lich dedicated to Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: the Cabal made a lich dedicated to Belzenlok

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu starts a ritual to resurrect Kyashatar; the Traveler duels him and lays her to rest again.
timeline.quote: the Traveler dueled Josu and laid Kyashatar to rest once again

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu raids the Dawnvault and Caligo Morass; the Traveler destroys him with Serra's help.
timeline.quote: With divine help from Serra , the Traveler destroyed Josu.

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabal reconstructs and reanimates the lich Josu.
timeline.quote: the Cabal soon found a way to both reconstruct and reanimate the lich that was Josu

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana lures the lich back to Vess Manor and breaks the lich spell with the Chain Veil; Josu tells her she is the real curse.
timeline.quote: She broke the lich spell with the help of the Chain Veil .

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu is afflicted by a magical illness in battle.
timeline.quote: when her brother Josu was afflicted by a magical illness in battle against their father's enemies

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana's cure drives Josu insane and poisons him anew.
timeline.quote: Truly, it cured Josu of his affliction, but only at the cost of driving him insane and poisoning him anew.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears to Liliana and offers a cure for her poisoned brother Josu, who is turned into a lich, igniting her spark.
timeline.quote: it came at the cost of turning him into a lich, an event that would ignite Liliana's planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Haunting Liliana Vess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse Josu Vess never died, so Liliana continues her studies as a healer and her spark never ignites; she becomes Professor Opal.
timeline.quote: In the Echoverse , Josu Vess never died, allowing his sister Liliana to continue her studies in Benalia as a healer.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "Professor Opal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu Vess has Kyashatar reanimated, and the Traveler slays the revenant.
timeline.quote: The Traveler then slew the reanimated Kyashatar, and Darigaaz saw to his proper burial.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess ascends as a planeswalker and the Lich Josu Vess is created.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess ascends as a planeswalker and the Lich Josu Vess is created from her brother's corpse.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
